detail: Sai Infinium Limited, dba Bandhan TMX, has filed a draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering of equity shares comprising a fresh issue of up to ₹280 crore and an offer for sale of up to 12,000,000 equity shares. Kanga & Company, Advocates and Solicitors is advising Sai Infinium as well as the book running lead managers Fedex Securities Private Limited and Neomile Capital Advisors Private Limited, on this IPO. The Firm assisted in carrying out due diligence of the documents of the Issuer, drafting the Draft Offer Document and preparing various agreements with intermediaries involved in the issue as well as in opining on various issues arising in the matter.
